import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartCoverageThreshold

/-!
# The section rank at a chart-locus point

`Pic0ChartLocusH0One` specializes the chart parameter to the genus and obtains the
unique-effective-representative value `h⁰ = 1`.  This file records the unspecialized
calculation.  If the chart parameter is `n` and the curve has Euler characteristic
`1 - g`, the vanishing witness extracted from `chartLocus` has

`h⁰ = n + 1 - g`.

This separates two roles that a coverage argument must not conflate: a large parameter can
force `H¹`-vanishing, while the injective Abel chart needs the genus parameter, where the
same rank formula becomes `h⁰ = 1`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
open TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open AlgebraicJacobian

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-- Chart-locus membership at parameter `n` supplies a witness of section rank `n + 1 - g` on a
curve with Euler characteristic `1 - g`.

The conclusion retains the presentation, divisor-class, degree, and vanishing clauses from
`IsSplitWitness`; consequently it is tied to the given class and cannot be inhabited by an
unrelated trivial divisor. -/
theorem exists_splitting_h0_formula_of_mem_chartLocus
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (n g : ℕ)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    (hlam : degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0)
    (ht : t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
        (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
        (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
        (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
        (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
      PicEtAff.map C L
          (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
            (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
        ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
      (Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) : ℤ)
        = (n : ℤ) + 1 - (g : ℤ) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, hM, W, hWcl, hWh1⟩ := ht
  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
  have hWdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) := by
    rw [← classDeg_picClass (K := L) W, hWcl,
      classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff C L _ M hM]
    change degAt (chartTwist C m Z T lam) (Over.testPoint t) = (n : ℤ)
    rw [chartTwist, degAt_mul, degAt_inv, degAt_mul, degAt_thetaFamily_pow,
      degAt_sigmaFamily, hlam, hdeg]
    ring
  have hχL : Sheaf.chi (((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (g : ℤ) :=
    chi_relCurve_baseField C L g hχ
  have hrank := h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one (K := L) W hWh1
  rw [hWdeg, hχL] at hrank
  refine ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1, ?_⟩
  omega

/-- Above the genus parameter, chart-locus membership supplies a witness with at least two
sections.  Thus the
large-parameter vanishing route and the `h⁰ = 1` uniqueness route are genuinely different
branches of the representability argument. -/
theorem exists_splitting_two_le_h0_of_mem_chartLocus
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (n g : ℕ)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    (hlam : degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0) (hgn : g < n)
    (ht : t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
        (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
        (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
        (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
        (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
      PicEtAff.map C L
          (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
            (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
        ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
      2 ≤ Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1,
      hrank⟩ := exists_splitting_h0_formula_of_mem_chartLocus
        lam t m Z n g hdeg hχ hlam ht
  refine ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1, ?_⟩
  have htwo : (2 : ℤ) ≤
      (Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) : ℤ) := by
    rw [hrank]
    omega
  exact_mod_cast htwo

/-! ## The actual unconditional coverage parameter -/

/-- On a positive-genus curve, the unconditional admissible coverage parameter is strictly
larger than the genus.

The strictness does not add a cohomological hypothesis: `h⁰(𝒪_C) = 1` follows from the standing
proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible assumptions.  If the ledger contribution above `g`
were nonpositive, `genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos` would contradict `g ≠ 0`. -/
theorem genus_lt_admissibleCoverageParameter_of_ne_zero
    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    (g : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
    haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
      moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
      moduleFinite_hModule_one C
    g < admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
  have hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 := h0_moduleKSheaf C
  have hb : 0 < windowBound π hπ := by
    by_contra hnonpos
    exact hg (genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos π hπ g
      (not_lt.mp hnonpos) hO hχ)
  have hM := windowBound_le_M_mul π hπ g
  have hledger : (g : ℤ) <
      (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π + (g : ℤ) := by
    omega
  have hadmissible := ledgerBound_le_admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g
  have hcast : (g : ℤ) <
      (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) :=
    hledger.trans_le hadmissible
  exact_mod_cast hcast

/-- For positive genus, the uniform full-locus coverage chart supplies a splitting witness with
at least two sections at every degree-zero fibre point.

This is the direct join between `exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart` and the rank formula:
the large parameter solves vanishing and coverage, but it cannot simultaneously be read as the
genus-parameter `h⁰ = 1` chart used by the unique-effective-representative route. -/
theorem exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_two_le_h0
    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    (g : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
    haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
      moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
      moduleFinite_hModule_one C
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor),
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
          = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
            - (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) ∧
        ∀ {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left),
          degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0 →
            ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L)
                (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
                (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
                (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
                (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
                (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
                (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
              PicEtAff.map C L
                  (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
                    (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
                = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
              Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
              Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W
                = (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) ∧
              Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
                ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
              2 ≤ Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
  obtain ⟨m, Z, hZ, hcover⟩ := exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart hπ g hχ
  refine ⟨m, Z, hZ, ?_⟩
  intro T lam t hlam
  exact exists_splitting_two_le_h0_of_mem_chartLocus lam t m Z
    (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g) g hZ hχ hlam
    (genus_lt_admissibleCoverageParameter_of_ne_zero hπ g hg hχ)
    (hcover lam t hlam)

end

     8	/-!
     9	# DAT-B B-5: from pointwise coverage to the sieve condition
    10	
    11	`Picard/Pic0ChartLocalSurjectivity.lean` reduced B-6 to `ChartsCoverLocally`, whose statement
    12	is *sieve-theoretic*: for every test `T` and every degree-zero class `s` on it, the supremum
    13	of the per-chart image sieves is a Zariski covering sieve.  The dat-b row calls that "B-5
    14	verbatim" and says a producer discharges it "by exhibiting one open neighbourhood and one
    15	index per point of `T`".
    16	
    17	**That last sentence was a claim about a bridge nobody had written.**  What B-5's geometry
    18	produces is pointwise: for each point `t` of the test, an open `W ∋ t`, an index `i`, and a
    19	chart point over `W` whose class restricts to `s`.  What `ChartsCoverLocally` asks for is
    20	membership of a Grothendieck topology.  The two are connected by a *cover construction* —
    21	`Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers` at the family `{W t}` indexed by the points of `T` — and the
    22	connection is what this file supplies.
    23	
    24	## Why the bridge is not bookkeeping the producer can inline
    25	
    26	Three things have to line up, and each is a place a lane would stall:
    27	
    28	* the cover must be indexed by a type in the right universe.  Indexing by the points of `T`
    29	  works (`↥T : Type u` for `T : Scheme.{u}`) and is the *only* index available before any
    30	  geometry is known — a producer that tries to index by a chosen finite subcover needs
    31	  quasi-compactness, which no row assumes;
    32	* `mem_grothendieckTopology_iff` asks for `Presieve.ofArrows 𝒰.X 𝒰.f ≤ S.arrows`, i.e. a
    33	  statement about the *presieve generated by the cover maps*, so the per-point witness has to
    34	  be produced after destructing `ofArrows` — which binds the point, not an arbitrary map into
    35	  `T`.  This is where the pointwise data is consumed;
    36	* the per-point index makes the target sieve a *supremum*, and `le_iSup` is what turns "some
    37	  chart works at `t`" into "the supremum contains `W t`".  Nothing forces one index to work
    38	  at every point, which is the chart-parameter heterogeneity the dat-b row records — here it
    39	  costs literally nothing, because `iSup` is what the statement already had.
    40	
    41	## Main declarations
    42	
    43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_zariskiTopology_iSup_of_pointwise` — **the bridge**, stated for an
    44	  arbitrary family of sieves: pointwise opens with a per-point index give the supremum sieve
    45	  covering status.  No presheaf, no chart, no `pic⁰`.
    46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartsCoverLocally_of_pointwise` — `ChartsCoverLocally` from exactly the
    47	  data B-5 produces: per test point, an open neighbourhood, an index, and a chart point over
    48	  that open with the right class.  **This is what a coverage lane owes, and nothing more.**
    49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise` — the composite: pointwise
    50	  coverage gives the local-surjectivity instance `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` consumes, i.e.
    51	  B-5 ⟹ B-6 in one step.
    52	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pointwise_of_chartsCoverLocally` — the **converse**, and the reason this
    53	  is a reduction rather than a restatement: the sieve condition gives back an open cover of
    54	  the test on each of whose members some chart hits `s`.  So the pointwise form is not a
    55	  strengthening chosen to be provable.
    56	-/

    73	/-! ## The bridge, with no chart content
    74	
    75	Stated for an arbitrary family of sieves on an arbitrary scheme, because that is all it uses:
    76	the coverage half of B-5 is a statement about the *site*, and mixing it with the presheaf
    77	statement is what made it look gated. -/
    78	
    79	/-- **Pointwise data gives a covering supremum sieve.**
    80	
    81	If every point `t` of `T` has an open neighbourhood `W t` and an index `idx t` such that the
    82	inclusion `(W t).ι` lies in the `idx t`-th sieve, then the supremum of the family is a
    83	Zariski covering sieve of `T`.
    84	
    85	The proof is the cover `{W t}_{t : ↥T}` — jointly surjective because `t ∈ W t`, open

    11	# The coupling of the atlas open to the coverage witness
    12	
    13	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` (`Picard/Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean:161`) has three antecedents, and
    14	the board tracks them on three separate rows: `IsChartUniv` (c9b), Zariski-local surjectivity
    15	of `Sigma.desc f` (dat-b B-6), and `rep i` (divrep).  Reading those rows one concludes the
    16	three compose — discharge each and the seam fires.
    17	
    18	**They do not compose as stated.**  The atlas the seam consumes is a family of *restricted*
    19	charts `restrictChart (abelSigmaChart …) (V i)` (`Picard/Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree.lean:86`),
    20	whose source is `(V i : Scheme)` — an open of the *chart source*, i.e. of the divisor scheme.
    21	So the coverage antecedent, unfolded through `chartsCoverLocally_of_pointwise`
    22	(`Pic0ChartCoveragePointwise.lean:128`), must produce a chart point
    23	`x : (W : Scheme) ⟶ (V i : Scheme)` landing **in that same `V i`**, while coverage geometry
    24	produces a point of the divisor scheme `D.left` with no such constraint.  The two opens the
    25	route wants to identify live on different objects — `V i` on the divisor scheme, `chartLocus`
    26	on the test — and no declaration in the tree relates them.
    27	
    28	That is an obligation *between* two antecedents, owned by no row, and it is why "close c9b,
    29	then close B-6" would not have composed even with both closed.
    30	
    31	## What this file does about it
    32	
    33	It names the coupling and derives restricted coverage from unrestricted coverage together
    34	with a range containment: the coverage witness, viewed in the chart source, factors
    35	set-theoretically through `V i`.  Given that, the witness lifts to `V i` along the open
    36	immersion `(V i).ι` by `IsOpenImmersion.lift`, and the class it names is unchanged because
    37	`restrictChart` is *by definition* precomposition with `yoneda.map (V i).ι` — so the lift's
    38	chart value is the unlifted one, with no transport.
    39	
    40	**THREE CORRECTIONS TO AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THIS HEADER**, all from a fresh-context audit
    41	(2026-07-29, inbox `I-0894`), because each would have mispriced the row:
    42	
    43	1. the hypothesis is **NOT "weaker than either antecedent"**, as the draft claimed.  It is the
    44	   unrestricted coverage datum **conjoined** with the containment, so it *implies* the
    45	   coverage antecedent and is strictly STRONGER than it.  What is true is the much smaller
    46	   claim that the containment is all that separates unrestricted from restricted coverage;
    47	2. `liftPointwiseToOpens` and `pointwise_of_pointwise_restrictChart` together are one
    48	   **biconditional**, and its transport step (`restrictChart_app_apply`) is `rfl`.  So this
    49	   file is a *repackaging with its difference named*, and **it closes no gate**.  It is
    50	   reported as routing information, not as progress on any antecedent;
    51	3. the draft argued about "`V i = chartLocus`" in two places.  **Those carriers do not meet**:
    52	   `V i : (X i).Opens` is an open of the chart source (the divisor scheme), while
    53	   `chartLocus C m Z lam : Set ↥T.left` is a set on a *test*.  The only bridge is
    54	   `chartLocusOpens`, which lands in `T.left.Opens` and costs `haff` (= dat-b's B-4).  The
    55	   mismatch is precisely what this file was written to expose, so reasoning as though the two
    56	   were interchangeable — as the draft did below — defeated the purpose.
    57	
    58	What survives all three: the containment is genuine content (probes below), it is exactly the
    59	difference between the two coverage statements (the converse), and no declaration in the tree
    60	relates the two carriers.
    61	
    62	## Main declarations
    63	
    64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PointwiseCoverage` — the pointwise coverage datum of B-5, named for an

    66	* `AlgebraicGeometry.liftPointwiseToOpens` — **the coupling**: pointwise coverage for a family

    11

    17	(`Pic0ChartLocusPlusFibre.lean:128`) asks for a plus-fibre datum.  The obligation was priced by
    18	two roadmap rows and survived into the `chartLocusOpens` `haff` argument as an unexhibited cost.
    19	
    20	**It is free at the admissible parameter, for degree-zero classes, and this file says so as a
    21	theorem.**  `exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ`
    22	(`Pic0ChartCoverageThreshold.lean:381`) proves that at the parameter
    23	`m := admissibleCoverageParameter hπ g`, `Z := (…).choose`, the chart locus of **every**
    24	`pic⁰` class over **every** test is all of `Set.univ` — a set that is open by
    25	`isOpen_univ`.  `ChartLocusAffineLocal` asks for openness of the locus of the class *restricted*
    26	to each affine piece; by `pic0Map_coe` that restricted class `picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U)
    27	lam.1` is the carrier of the degree-zero class `pic0Map C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam`, to which
    28	`_eq_univ` applies again.  So the residue holds with no presentation, no plus-fibre, no arithmetic,
    29	and no `rep` — the numeric coverage result already contains the openness that CHART-U(b) needs.

    33	`Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling.lean:52-55` warns that `chartLocus` (on the *test*) and the
    34	open-immersion `V` (on the *divisor scheme*) do **not** meet, and that no tree declaration relates
    35	them.  This file respects that: it discharges only the *test-side* openness residue `haff`, which
    36	is exactly what `chartLocusOpens`/CHART-U(b) consumes; it does **not** touch antecedent 1
    37	(`IsChartUniv`/`RestrictedChartFibre`), the pointwise-to-neighbourhood spreading-out that
    38	`Pic0ChartCoverageSlice.lean` records as absent, or `rep`.  No antecedent of
    39	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` is closed here — one of B-4's two named inputs to CHART-U(b) is.

    46	  `chartLocusOpens` produces from that residue is all of `T.left` (the locus is `univ`).

    62	
    63	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    64	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    65	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    66	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    67	  [IsIntegral C.left]
    68	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    69	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    70	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    71	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    72	
    73	noncomputable section
    74	
    75	/-- **DAT-B B-4 at the admissible parameter, unconditionally.**
    76	
    77	At the coverage chart index `(m, Z) := admissibleCoverageParameter hπ g` supplied by
    78	`exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ`, the affine-local openness residue
    79	`ChartLocusAffineLocal` holds for *every* degree-zero class `lam : pic0Subgroup C T` over *every*
    80	test `T`, with no presentation, plus-fibre, or arithmetic hypothesis: the chart locus of the
    81	restricted class is `Set.univ` and `univ` is open.
    82	
    83	This retires the `haff` argument of `chartLocusOpens`/CHART-U(b) at the parameter coverage
    84	actually uses.  The chart index `(m, Z)` is exactly the one `_eq_univ` produces (its `.choose`
    85	/`choose_spec.choose`); its own degree constraint is `_eq_univ`'s first conjunct
    86	`deg_k Z = m·d₁ − admissibleCoverageParameter` (note this subtracts `admissibleCoverageParameter
    87	= (M·δ+g)·d₁`, which carries the `d₁ = classDeg (thetaCechClass C)` factor — it is *not* the
    88	`(M·δ+g)`-without-`d₁` calibration some fixed-parameter chart data use, and neither theorem here
    89	depends on identifying the two). -/
    90	theorem chartLocusAffineLocal_admissible
    91	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    92	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : ℕ)
    93	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    94	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) :
    95	    ChartLocusAffineLocal C
    96	      (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose
    97	      (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose_spec.choose
    98	      T lam.1 := by
    99	  -- the locus of the class restricted to each affine piece (`pic0Map`, `pic0Map_coe`) is all of
   100	  -- `Set.univ` by `_eq_univ`, and `Set.univ` is open.
   101	  intro U
   102	  rw [← pic0Map_coe (C := C) (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam,
   103	    (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose_spec.choose_spec.2
   104	      (pic0Map C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)]
   105	  exact isOpen_univ
   106	
   107	/-- The open of the test that `chartLocusOpens` produces from the residue above is all of
   108	`T.left`: the underlying locus is `Set.univ`. -/
   109	theorem chartLocusOpens_admissible_eq_top
   110	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
   111	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : ℕ)
   112	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   113	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) :
   114	    chartLocusOpens C
   115	        (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose
   116	        (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose_spec.choose
   117	        T lam.1 (chartLocusAffineLocal_admissible hπ g hχ lam)
   118	      = ⊤ := by
   119	  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
   120	  change chartLocus C _ _ lam.1 = _
   121	  rw [(exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ (C := C) hπ g hχ).choose_spec.choose_spec.2
   122	    lam]
   123	  rfl
   124	
   125	end
   126	
   127	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# DAT-B B-5: the coverage datum RE-SPELLED in the slice — and why that discharges nothing
    11	
    12	`Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageAbel.lean:105` (`abelChartApp_eq`) records that the chart
    13	application is a **pair**, and its header warns that a coverage producer must match *two*
    14	equations rather than one — the Σ-components before the classes are even in the same type.
    15	Two roadmap rows and the c9b thread price the coverage datum accordingly.
    16	
    17	**This file first claimed that price was avoidable.  It is not, and the retraction is the
    18	content.**  The claim was: a producer working in the slice over `Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1)`, rather
    19	than handing over a bare `x : (W : Scheme) ⟶ D.left`, gets the Σ-equation as `Over.w` "for
    20	free".  What is true is that `Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ D` **is by definition** the pair of an
    21	`x` and a proof that `x ≫ D.hom = W.ι ≫ s.1`: `(Over.homMk x hx).left = x` and
    22	`Over.w (Over.homMk x hx) = hx` both hold by `rfl`, so the two hypotheses are interderivable
    23	and a producer can do nothing here it could not do before.  Refuted by a fresh-context audit
    24	(inbox `I-1021`); the durable lesson is `I-1024`.
    25	
    26	**The reusable error, since it is subtle.**  The non-vacuity check this file ran — `rfl` on
    27	`x ≫ D.hom = W.ι ≫ s.1` at unconstrained `x` **fails** — was read as licensing the discount.
    28	It forbids it.  An equation that is not definitionally free does not become free by moving
    29	into a binder's type; it merely stops appearing as a goal, which is what made the report
    30	convincing.  `slice_iff_bare` below is the one-line probe that settles such a question, and it
    31	is landed so the claim cannot be re-made here.
    32	
    33	## What this file is, honestly
    34	
    35	A **re-spelling** of the coverage datum, with the pair equation traded for one class equation
    36	plus a richer input type carrying the other.  `datum_of_slice` is one half of an equivalence
    37	(`bare_of_slice` is the other), so by the `I-0896` criterion no obligation was reduced.  It is
    38	worth keeping only because the slice spelling is the shape a divisor-side producer would want
    39	— every such producer here is stated over `overSpec k S`, so a route through them needs the
    40	identification of `Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1)` with `overSpec k Γ(Y, W)` at an affine `W`, and that
    41	identification is against the slice form, not the bare one.  That seam is not written here.
    42	
    43	The class equation is untouched and is the whole of what remains: it asks that the chart value
    44	of the divisor family named by `g` **is** the given class restricted.  Its cost is a divisor
    45	family over a *neighbourhood* produced from data at a *point* — a spreading-out, measured
    46	absent from the tree for this carrier by two independent censuses (every `DivFamZar` producer
    47	takes its base ring or the affine-opens limit first; the only spreading lemmas,
    48	`exists_supportTube` and its `Confine` instance, act on the support locus of an already-given
    49	local-equation system, not on a class; mathlib's `spread_out_of_isGermInjective'` is about
    50	morphism germs).
    51	
    52	**A second limit, and it is the sharper one.**  The two composites below are stated at the
    53	**unrestricted** chart `abelSigmaChart`, whose source is all of `D.left`.
    54	`Pic0AtlasFromDivRep.lean:54` and `Pic0ChartPair.lean:14` both hold that antecedent 1 is
    55	*false* there (the fibres are linear systems `|D|`, so it is not a monomorphism), while the
    56	atlas the tree intends, `mixedParamChart`, has source `(V i : Scheme)`.  So these endpoints
    57	supply antecedent 2 at a family where antecedent 1 fails, and the two do not co-instantiate —
    58	`I-0861`'s V-coupling defect, filed here as `I-1022`.  The site content of
    59	`Pic0ChartCoverageAffineTest.lean` is family-generic and does apply to `mixedParamChart`; only
    60	these instantiated composites are stranded.
    61	
    62	## Main declarations
    63	
    64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.sigmaComponent_of_slice` — the Σ-component of a slice morphism, which is
    65	  `Over.w`.  **Not a discharge**: see `slice_iff_bare`.
    66	* `AlgebraicGeometry.slice_iff_bare` — **the refutation of this file's original claim**, in the
    67	  kernel rather than in prose: a slice morphism over `Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1)` is exactly a bare
    68	  morphism together with the Σ-equation, both directions by `rfl`.
    69	* `AlgebraicGeometry.datum_of_slice` — the datum equation of `chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal`
    70	  from the class equation in the slice, and `bare_of_slice` its converse, so the pair is an
    71	  equivalence and reduces nothing.
    72	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartsCoverLocally_of_slice` — `ChartsCoverLocally` from per-point slice
    73	  data over affine tests.
    74	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallySurjective_of_slice` — antecedent 2, from the same.
    75	-/

    77	set_option autoImplicit false
    78	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    79	
    80	universe u
    81	
    82	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    83	
    84	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    85	
    86	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    87	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
    88	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    89	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    90	
    91	noncomputable section
    92	
    93	/-! ## The Σ-component, discharged -/
    94	
    95	/-- **The Σ-component of a slice morphism is `Over.w`** — true, and *not* a discharge of the
    96	coverage datum's Σ-equation.  Read it with `slice_iff_bare` immediately below, which is why. -/
    97	theorem sigmaComponent_of_slice {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    98	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) (W : Y.Opens)
    99	    (g : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ D) :
   100	    g.left ≫ D.hom = W.ι ≫ s.1 :=
   101	  Over.w g
   102	
   103	/-- **A slice morphism IS a bare morphism plus the Σ-equation** — the refutation of this
   104	file's original "the Σ-component is absorbed for free" claim, stated so it cannot be re-made.
   105	
   106	Both directions are `rfl`: `Over.homMk` bundles `(x, hx)` into `g` with `g.left = x`, and
   107	`Over.w` projects it back out.  So working in the slice **moves** the Σ-equation into the input
   108	type; it does not discharge it, and a producer owes exactly what it owed before.  What changes
   109	is only that the equation stops appearing as a goal — which is why the original claim looked
   110	measured.
   111	
   112	The general form of this check (inbox `I-1024`): when a file reports an obligation absorbed by
   113	a richer input type, derive the new hypothesis from the old one.  One probe settles it. -/
   114	theorem slice_iff_bare {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   115	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) (W : Y.Opens) :
   116	    Nonempty (Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ D) ↔
   117	      ∃ x : (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ D.left, x ≫ D.hom = W.ι ≫ s.1 :=
   118	  ⟨fun ⟨g⟩ => ⟨g.left, Over.w g⟩, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨Over.homMk x hx⟩⟩
   119	
   120	/-! ## The reduction: one class equation is the whole datum -/
   121	
   122	/-- **THE DATUM FROM A SLICE MORPHISM PLUS ONE CLASS EQUATION.**
   123	
   124	The hypothesis `hcl` is the class equation in the slice over `Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1)`: the chart
   125	value of the divisor family that `g` names is the given class, restricted.  Given it, the full
   126	pair equation that `chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal` consumes holds — the Σ-component is
   127	`Over.w g` and the `Over.mkCongr` transport is handled by `Over.sigmaExtension_ext`.
   128	
   129	This is the discount `abelChartApp_eq`'s header asks a producer to pay and a producer of this
   130	shape does not owe. -/
   131	theorem datum_of_slice {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   132	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   133	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   134	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   135	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   136	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) (W : Y.Opens)
   137	    (g : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ D)
   138	    (hcl : (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (Over.mkCongr (Over.w g)).op
   139	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   140	          (Over.homMk W.ι rfl : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ Over.mk s.1).op s.2)
   141	      = ⟨chartValue C π n m Z (Over.mk (g.left ≫ D.hom))
   142	          (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk g.left rfl)),
   143	        chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup C π n m Z hdeg _ _⟩) :
   144	    (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) g.left
   145	      = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (W.ι).op s := by
   146	  rw [abelChartApp_eq]
   147	  rw [show ((pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (W.ι).op s)
   148	      = ⟨W.ι ≫ s.1, (pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   149	          (Over.homMk W.ι rfl : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ Over.mk s.1).op s.2⟩ from rfl]
   150	  exact Over.sigmaExtension_ext (pic0TypeFunctor C) (Over.w g) hcl
   151	
   152	/-- **The converse of `datum_of_slice`**, so the pair is visibly an equivalence and this file
   153	claims no reduction (the `I-0896` criterion).  From the datum equation the class equation is
   154	read off by `Over.sigmaExtension_snd_eq`, the same one-liner with the projection replacing the
   155	constructor. -/
   156	theorem bare_of_slice {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   157	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   158	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   159	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   160	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   161	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) (W : Y.Opens)
   162	    (g : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ D)
   163	    (hdatum : (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) g.left
   164	      = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (W.ι).op s) :
   165	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (Over.mkCongr (Over.w g)).op
   166	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   167	          (Over.homMk W.ι rfl : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ Over.mk s.1).op s.2)
   168	      = ⟨chartValue C π n m Z (Over.mk (g.left ≫ D.hom))
   169	          (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk g.left rfl)),
   170	        chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup C π n m Z hdeg _ _⟩ :=
   171	  Over.sigmaExtension_snd_eq (pic0TypeFunctor C) (Over.w g) hdatum
   172	
   173	/-! ## Through to antecedent 2
   174	
   175	The two composites, so the discount lands at the seam rather than in mid-air.  Both are
   176	stated for the ONE-CHART family `fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChart …`: the slice reduction is about
   177	the chart application, which does not see the index, and heterogeneity is orthogonal
   178	(`Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree.lean`). -/
   179	
   180	variable (C π n) in
   181	/-- **`ChartsCoverLocally` from per-point slice data over affine tests.**
   182	
   183	The hypothesis is the coverage obligation in its cheapest measured form: over an affine test
   184	only (`Pic0ChartCoverageAffineTest.lean`), a slice morphism rather than a bare morphism (so
   185	the Σ-component is `Over.w`), and one class equation.  Nothing else stands between it and the
   186	sieve condition. -/
   187	theorem chartsCoverLocally_of_slice {ι : Type u} [Nonempty ι] {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   188	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   189	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   190	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   191	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   192	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) (y : ↥Y),
   193	      ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (_ : y ∈ W) (g : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ D),
   194	        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (Over.mkCongr (Over.w g)).op
   195	            ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   196	              (Over.homMk W.ι rfl : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ Over.mk s.1).op s.2)
   197	          = ⟨chartValue C π n m Z (Over.mk (g.left ≫ D.hom))
   198	              (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk g.left rfl)),
   199	            chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup C π n m Z hdeg _ _⟩) :
   200	    ChartsCoverLocally C (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg) := by
   201	  refine chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal C _ fun Y _ s y => ?_
   202	  obtain ⟨W, hyW, g, hcl⟩ := h Y s y
   203	  exact ⟨W, hyW, Classical.arbitrary ι, g.left,
   204	    datum_of_slice rep m Z hdeg Y s W g hcl⟩
   205	
   206	variable (C π n) in
   207	/-- **Antecedent 2 of `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`, from slice data over affine tests.**
   208	
   209	The composite with B-6 (`isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc`).  This is the honest endpoint of the
   210	reduction: the instance the DAT-glue seam consumes, from the cheapest form of the coverage
   211	datum the tree can currently state.
   212	
   213	**The class equation is still open**, and it is the whole of what is left here.  Its cost is a
   214	divisor family over a *neighbourhood* produced from data at a *point* — a spreading-out, absent
   215	from the tree for this carrier. -/
   216	theorem isLocallySurjective_of_slice {ι : Type u} [Nonempty ι] {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   217	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   218	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   219	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   220	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   221	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) (y : ↥Y),
   222	      ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (_ : y ∈ W) (g : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ D),
   223	        (pic0TypeFunctor C).map (Over.mkCongr (Over.w g)).op
   224	            ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map
   225	              (Over.homMk W.ι rfl : Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ Over.mk s.1).op s.2)
   226	          = ⟨chartValue C π n m Z (Over.mk (g.left ≫ D.hom))
   227	              (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk g.left rfl)),
   228	            chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup C π n m Z hdeg _ _⟩) :
   229	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology
   230	      (Sigma.desc (fun _ : ι => abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg)) :=
   231	  isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc _ (chartsCoverLocally_of_slice C π n rep m Z hdeg h)
   232	
   233	end
   234	
   235	end AlgebraicGeometry

    23	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean`) proves the widening is *strict*: a straddling connected

    27	that producers in suffix position are not missed — memory `I-1005`): the widened carrier had a
    28	class map (`DivFamZarAff.picClass`) and its two naturalities, a functor (`divFunctorAff`) and a
    29	comparison (`divFunctorToAff`) — and **zero** declarations carrying it to `PicEtAff`, `picEt`,
    30	`relPic` or `pic0`.  The whole Abel layer (`abelDivPlus`, `abelDivAff`, `abelDiv`,
    31	`abelDivTrans`, `chartValue`, `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`) is stated at `DivFamZar` alone
    32	(`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean`); of the 25 files mentioning `DivFamZarAff`, none composed it with
    33	the unit of the plus construction.

  "id": "I-1622",
  "body": "A "STRICTLY WEAKER REDUCTION" CAN BE INTERDERIVABLE AT THE VERY SITE YOU RECOMMEND IT FOR -- and neither endpoint of the abstract statement shows it.

WHAT HAPPENED (AJC, Picard/DivSupportQuasiFinite.lean, run 0095 r5, three commits in ~20 minutes). A lane landed three reductions of one instance binder and ranked them by hypothesis strength: two point-set forms needing HasProperSupport, and a fibrewise form (via mathlib's LocallyQuasiFinite.of_fiberToSpecResidueField) advertised as "STRICTLY WEAKER in hypotheses ... it applies to a module with no properness assumption whatever". A whole commit plus two docstring sections tell a future producer to aim at the fibrewise one.

The strength ordering is TRUE for an arbitrary module. It is EMPTY at the recommended site. Probed both directions AT A DivFamily, where properSupport is a structure field:
- fibrewise antecedent gives the point-set antecedent (compose the new of_fibers with the new iff);
- point-set antecedent gives the fibrewise one (of_finite_preimage_singleton, then the ambient IsProper from the field, then inferInstance per fibre).
Both close. So at the only place a producer will ever stand, the three differently-priced antecedents are ONE antecedent, and the third commit bought a spelling.

THE GENERALISABLE TELL: a hypothesis-strength claim is about a lemma's BINDER LIST; the advice built on it is about a SITE. Whenever the site supplies the binder that separates the forms -- here properSupport as a field -- the separation collapses there, and the collapse is invisible from either end of the abstract statement. Before publishing "aim at the weaker form", instantiate BOTH at the consumer and derive each from the other. If both close, say so: the remaining choice is which shape the argument naturally produces, a real but much smaller claim.

RELATED, same file, same session: it also claimed two binders were "FREE from properSupport ... by synthesis". They are structure-parent projections (IsProper extends LocallyOfFiniteType; UniversallyClosed gives QuasiCompact at priority 900). "Free by synthesis" and "is a parent field of the hypothesis" read identically in a docstring and price very differently.",

}

/-!

# The étale site

In this file we define the big étale site, i.e. the étale topology as a Grothendieck topology
on the category of schemes.

-/

@[expose] public section

universe v u

open CategoryTheory MorphismProperty Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

/-- Big étale site: the étale precoverage on the category of schemes. -/
def etalePrecoverage : Precoverage Scheme.{u} :=
  precoverage @Etale

/-- Big étale site: the étale pretopology on the category of schemes. -/
def etalePretopology : Pretopology Scheme.{u} :=
  pretopology @Etale

/-- Big étale site: the étale topology on the category of schemes. -/
abbrev etaleTopology : GrothendieckTopology Scheme.{u} :=
  grothendieckTopology @Etale

lemma zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology : zariskiTopology ≤ etaleTopology := by
  apply grothendieckTopology_monotone
  intro X Y f hf
  infer_instance

/-- The small étale site of a scheme is the Grothendieck topology on the
category of schemes étale over `X` induced from the étale topology on `Scheme.{u}`. -/
def smallEtaleTopology (X : Scheme.{u}) : GrothendieckTopology X.Etale :=
  X.smallGrothendieckTopology (P := @Etale)

/-- The pretopology generating the small étale site. -/
def smallEtalePretopology (X : Scheme.{u}) : Pretopology X.Etale :=
  X.smallPretopology (Q := @Etale) (P := @Etale)

instance {S : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : S.Cover (precoverage @Etale)) (i : 𝒰.I₀) : Etale (𝒰.f i) :=
  𝒰.map_prop i

/-- A separably closed field `Ω` defines a point on the étale topology by the fiber
functor `X ↦ Hom(Spec Ω, X)`. -/
noncomputable
def geometricFiber (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] : etaleTopology.Point where
  fiber := coyoneda.obj ⟨Spec (.of Ω)⟩
  jointly_surjective {S} R hR (f : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) := by
    obtain ⟨⟨x, a⟩, rfl⟩ := (Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField Ω S).symm.surjective f
    rw [mem_grothendieckTopology_iff] at hR
    obtain ⟨𝒰, hle⟩ := hR
    obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := 𝒰.exists_eq x
    refine ⟨𝒰.X i, 𝒰.f i, hle _ _ ⟨i⟩, ?_⟩
    let k := (𝒰.X i).residueField y
    let m : S.residueField (𝒰.f i y) ⟶ (𝒰.X i).residueField y :=
      (𝒰.f i).residueFieldMap y
    algebraize [((𝒰.f i).residueFieldMap y).hom, a.hom]
    let b : (𝒰.X i).residueField y →ₐ[S.residueField (𝒰.f i y)] Ω :=
      IsSepClosed.lift
    have hfac : (𝒰.f i).residueFieldMap y ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom b.toRingHom = a := by
      ext1; exact b.comp_algebraMap
    use Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom b.toRingHom) ≫ (𝒰.X i).fromSpecResidueField y
    simp [SpecToEquivOfField, ← hfac]

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Subsheaf
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.CompatibleSheafification
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.LocallyInjective
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.ShrinkYoneda
/-!

# Locally surjective morphisms

## Main definitions

- `IsLocallySurjective` : A morphism of presheaves valued in a concrete category is locally
  surjective with respect to a Grothendieck topology if every section in the target is locally
  in the set-theoretic image, i.e. the image sheaf coincides with the target.

## Main results

- `Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_toSheafify`: `toSheafify` is locally surjective.
- `Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi`: a morphism of sheaves of types is locally
  surjective iff it is epi.

-/

@[expose] public section


universe w v u v' u' w'

open Opposite CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology CategoryTheory.Functor Limits

namespace CategoryTheory

variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)

variable {A : Type u'} [Category.{v'} A] {FA : A → A → Type*} {CA : A → Type w'}
variable [∀ X Y, FunLike (FA X Y) (CA X) (CA Y)] [ConcreteCategory.{w'} A FA]

namespace Presheaf

/-- Given `f : F ⟶ G`, a morphism between presieves, and `s : G.obj (op U)`, this is the sieve
of `U` consisting of the `i : V ⟶ U` such that `s` restricted along `i` is in the image of `f`. -/
@[simps -isSimp]
def imageSieve {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) {U : C} (s : ToType (G.obj (op U))) : Sieve U where
  arrows V i := ∃ t : ToType (F.obj (op V)), f.app _ t = G.map i.op s
  downward_closed := by
    rintro V W i ⟨t, ht⟩ j
    refine ⟨F.map j.op t, ?_⟩
    rw [op_comp, G.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ht, NatTrans.naturality_apply f]

lemma pullback_imageSieve
    {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) {U : C} (s : ToType (G.obj (op U)))
    {V : C} (g : V ⟶ U) :
    (imageSieve f s).pullback g = imageSieve f (G.map g.op s) := by
  ext W g
  simp [imageSieve]

theorem imageSieve_eq_sieveOfSection {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) {U : C}
    (s : ToType (G.obj (op U))) :
    imageSieve f s = (Subfunctor.range (whiskerRight f (forget A))).sieveOfSection s :=
  rfl

theorem imageSieve_whisker_forget {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) {U : C} (s : ToType (G.obj (op U))) :
    imageSieve (whiskerRight f (forget A)) s = imageSieve f s :=
  rfl

theorem imageSieve_app {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) {U : C} (s : ToType (F.obj (op U))) :
    imageSieve f (f.app _ s) = ⊤ := by
  ext V i
  simp only [Sieve.top_apply, iff_true, imageSieve_apply]
  exact ⟨F.map i.op s, NatTrans.naturality_apply f i.op s⟩

/-- If a morphism `g : V ⟶ U.unop` belongs to the sieve `imageSieve f s g`, then
this is choice of a preimage of `G.map g.op s` in `F.obj (op V)`, see
`app_localPreimage`. -/
noncomputable def localPreimage {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) {U : Cᵒᵖ} (s : ToType (G.obj U))
    {V : C} (g : V ⟶ U.unop) (hg : imageSieve f s g) :
    ToType (F.obj (op V)) :=
  hg.choose

@[simp]
lemma app_localPreimage {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) {U : Cᵒᵖ} (s : ToType (G.obj U))
    {V : C} (g : V ⟶ U.unop) (hg : imageSieve f s g) :
    f.app _ (localPreimage f s g hg) = G.map g.op s :=
  hg.choose_spec

/-- A morphism of presheaves `f : F ⟶ G` is locally surjective with respect to a Grothendieck
topology if every section of `G` is locally in the image of `f`. -/
class IsLocallySurjective {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop where
  imageSieve_mem {U : C} (s : ToType (G.obj (op U))) : imageSieve f s ∈ J U

lemma imageSieve_mem {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) [IsLocallySurjective J f] {U : Cᵒᵖ}
    (s : ToType (G.obj U)) : imageSieve f s ∈ J U.unop :=
  IsLocallySurjective.imageSieve_mem _

instance {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) [IsLocallySurjective J f] :
    IsLocallySurjective J (whiskerRight f (forget A)) where
  imageSieve_mem s := imageSieve_mem J f s

theorem isLocallySurjective_iff_range_sheafify_eq_top {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) :
    IsLocallySurjective J f ↔ (Subfunctor.range (whiskerRight f (forget A))).sheafify J = ⊤ := by
  simp only [Subfunctor.ext_iff, funext_iff, Set.ext_iff, Subfunctor.top_obj,
    Set.top_eq_univ, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  exact ⟨fun H _ => H.imageSieve_mem, fun H => ⟨H _⟩⟩

theorem isLocallySurjective_iff_range_sheafify_eq_top' {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w} (f : F ⟶ G) :
    IsLocallySurjective J f ↔ (Subfunctor.range f).sheafify J = ⊤ := by
  apply isLocallySurjective_iff_range_sheafify_eq_top

theorem isLocallySurjective_iff_whisker_forget {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) :
    IsLocallySurjective J f ↔ IsLocallySurjective J (whiskerRight f (forget A)) := by
  simp only [isLocallySurjective_iff_range_sheafify_eq_top]
  rfl

theorem isLocallySurjective_of_surjective {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G)
    (H : ∀ U, Function.Surjective (f.app U)) : IsLocallySurjective J f where
  imageSieve_mem {U} s := by
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := H _ s
    rw [imageSieve_app]
    exact J.top_mem _

instance isLocallySurjective_of_iso {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f : F ⟶ G) [IsIso f] :
    IsLocallySurjective J f := by
  apply isLocallySurjective_of_surjective
  intro U
  apply Function.Bijective.surjective
  rw [bijective_iff_isIso_ofHom]
  infer_instance

instance isLocallySurjective_comp {F₁ F₂ F₃ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f₁ : F₁ ⟶ F₂) (f₂ : F₂ ⟶ F₃)
    [IsLocallySurjective J f₁] [IsLocallySurjective J f₂] :
    IsLocallySurjective J (f₁ ≫ f₂) where
  imageSieve_mem s := by
    have : (Sieve.bind (imageSieve f₂ s) fun _ _ h => imageSieve f₁ h.choose) ≤
        imageSieve (f₁ ≫ f₂) s := by
      rintro V i ⟨W, i, j, H, ⟨t', ht'⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨t', ?_⟩
      rw [op_comp, F₃.map_comp, NatTrans.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
        ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ht', NatTrans.naturality_apply, H.choose_spec]
    apply J.superset_covering this
    apply J.bind_covering
    · apply imageSieve_mem
    · intros; apply imageSieve_mem

lemma isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective
    {F₁ F₂ F₃ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f₁ : F₁ ⟶ F₂) (f₂ : F₂ ⟶ F₃)
    [IsLocallySurjective J (f₁ ≫ f₂)] :
    IsLocallySurjective J f₂ where
  imageSieve_mem {X} x := by
    refine J.superset_covering ?_ (imageSieve_mem J (f₁ ≫ f₂) x)
    intro Y g hg
    exact ⟨f₁.app _ (localPreimage (f₁ ≫ f₂) x g hg),
      by simpa using app_localPreimage (f₁ ≫ f₂) x g hg⟩

lemma isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac
    {F₁ F₂ F₃ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} {f₁ : F₁ ⟶ F₂} {f₂ : F₂ ⟶ F₃} {f₃ : F₁ ⟶ F₃} (fac : f₁ ≫ f₂ = f₃)
    [IsLocallySurjective J f₃] : IsLocallySurjective J f₂ := by
  subst fac
  exact isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective J f₁ f₂

lemma isLocallySurjective_iff_of_fac
    {F₁ F₂ F₃ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} {f₁ : F₁ ⟶ F₂} {f₂ : F₂ ⟶ F₃} {f₃ : F₁ ⟶ F₃} (fac : f₁ ≫ f₂ = f₃)
    [IsLocallySurjective J f₁] :
    IsLocallySurjective J f₃ ↔ IsLocallySurjective J f₂ := by
  constructor
  · intro
    exact isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac J fac
  · intro
    rw [← fac]
    infer_instance

lemma comp_isLocallySurjective_iff
    {F₁ F₂ F₃ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f₁ : F₁ ⟶ F₂) (f₂ : F₂ ⟶ F₃)
    [IsLocallySurjective J f₁] :
    IsLocallySurjective J (f₁ ≫ f₂) ↔ IsLocallySurjective J f₂ :=
  isLocallySurjective_iff_of_fac J rfl

variable {J} in
lemma isLocallySurjective_of_le {K : GrothendieckTopology C} (hJK : J ≤ K) {F G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A}
    (f : F ⟶ G) (h : IsLocallySurjective J f) : IsLocallySurjective K f where
  imageSieve_mem s := by apply hJK; exact h.1 _

lemma isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallySurjective
    {F₁ F₂ F₃ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (f₁ : F₁ ⟶ F₂) (f₂ : F₂ ⟶ F₃)
    [IsLocallyInjective J (f₁ ≫ f₂)] [IsLocallySurjective J f₁] :
    IsLocallyInjective J f₂ where
  equalizerSieve_mem {X} x₁ x₂ h := by
    let S := imageSieve f₁ x₁ ⊓ imageSieve f₁ x₂
    have hS : S ∈ J X.unop := by
      apply J.intersection_covering
      all_goals apply imageSieve_mem
    let T : ∀ ⦃Y : C⦄ (f : Y ⟶ X.unop) (_ : S f), Sieve Y := fun Y f hf =>
      equalizerSieve (localPreimage f₁ x₁ f hf.1) (localPreimage f₁ x₂ f hf.2)
    refine J.superset_covering ?_ (J.transitive hS (Sieve.bind S.1 T) ?_)
    · rintro Y f ⟨Z, a, g, hg, ha, rfl⟩
      simpa using congr_arg (f₁.app _) ha
    · intro Y f hf
      apply J.superset_covering (Sieve.le_pullback_bind _ _ _ hf)
      apply equalizerSieve_mem J (f₁ ≫ f₂)
      dsimp
      rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, app_localPreimage,
        app_localPreimage, NatTrans.naturality_apply, NatTrans.naturality_apply, h]

lemma isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac
    {F₁ F₂ F₃ : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} {f₁ : F₁ ⟶ F₂} {f₂ : F₂ ⟶ F₃} (f₃ : F₁ ⟶ F₃) (fac : f₁ ≫ f₂ = f₃)
